comment: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) agent configuration for AgriOps MCP.
comment2: Place this alongside your ADK agent definition (agent.py / agent.ts).

tools.name: agriops-mcp
tools.description: Japanese agricultural data — farmland polygons (eMAFF), 1 km mesh weather (Open-Meteo), and pesticide registrations (FAMIC) for SSW workforce dispatching.

auth.comment: For Cloud Run IAM-protected endpoints, the ADK runner should obtain an ID token via Workload Identity Federation and pass it as a Bearer token.

system_prompt: You are an agricultural operations assistant for Japanese farms managed by WIN Kagoshima. Use the agriops-mcp tools to look up farmland, weather, and pesticide data. Always quote the `attribution` field when presenting data to the user.
